scenario: [LNRE.3.1] / [LNRE.1.1] `regex: false` forbids the whole regular-expression surface, `!~` as well as `~`. A negated match in `where` under `regex: false` is DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DISABLED. compiler/LDIA.3.4.2_capability_disabled pins only `~`; a check keyed on the `~` operator node alone would pass that fixture and accept this one.
rules_ds:
use default:
    regex: false

schema Msg scope logical:
    id: Int key
    text: String mutable

rule r:
    Msg m where m.text !~ /alarm/
->
    log info "x"
